local _m_utils = require('Module:Utils')
local _m_quote_db = _m_utils._json_to_table(mw.loadJsonData('Module:WotQ/Data/quotes.json'))

local obj = {}

function obj._add_tag(tag)
    if tag == nil then return end
    local aliases = tag.aliases
    if aliases == nil then aliases = {} end
    for _, k in ipairs({"page", "short", "name"}) do
        if tag[k] ~= nil then table.insert(aliases, tag[k]) end
    end
    tag.page = tag.page and tag.page or (tag.name and tag.name or tag.short)
    tag.name = tag.name and tag.name or (tag.page and tag.page or tag.short)
    tag.short = tag.short and tag.short or (tag.name and tag.name or tag.page)
    if not tag.short then error("No short, name, or page provided: ".._m_utils.encode(tag)) end
    local short_lc = string.lower(tag.short)
    if obj.tags[short_lc] then error("Duplicate tag: "..short_lc) end
    obj.tags[short_lc] = tag
    tag.aliases = nil
    for _, v in ipairs(aliases) do
        local v_lc = string.lower(v)
        local add = true
        if tag.aliases ~= nil then
            for _, a in ipairs(tag.aliases) do
                if v_lc == string.lower(a) then
                    add = false
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if add then
            if tag.aliases == nil then tag.aliases = {} end
            table.insert(tag.aliases, v_lc)
        end
    end
    table.sort(tag.aliases)
    for _, alias in ipairs(tag.aliases) do if obj.aliases[alias] == nil then obj.aliases[alias] = tag end end
end

function obj.get_output(frame)
    return "<pre>"..frame:callParserFunction('#tag', { 'nowiki', obj.output }).."</pre>"
    -- return "<pre>"..obj.output.."</pre>"
end

-- Gather all the explicitly defined tags
obj.tags = {}
obj.aliases = {}
for _, db_tag in pairs(_m_quote_db.tags) do
    obj._add_tag(db_tag)
end

-- Gather all the implicitly defined tags
obj._add_tag({ short = "all", implicit = true, quotes = {} })
for _, quote in ipairs(_m_quote_db.quotes) do
    if not quote.speakers and type(quote.quote) == "table" then
        quote.speakers = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(quote.quote) do
            for key, _ in pairs(line) do
                local key_lc = string.lower(key)
                if key_lc ~= "quote_marks" then
                    local add = true
                    for _, s in ipairs(quote.speakers) do
                        if key_lc == string.lower(s) then
                            add = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if add then table.insert(quote.speakers, key) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for _, l in ipairs({ quote.speakers or false, quote.addressees or false, quote.tags or false, { quote.pseudosource or false } }) do
        if l then
            for _, v in ipairs(l) do
                if v then
                    local v_lc = string.lower(v)
                    local add = true
                    for k, _ in pairs(obj.aliases) do
                        if v_lc == string.lower(k) then
                            add = false
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if add and obj.aliases[v_lc] == nil then obj._add_tag({ short = v, implicit = true }) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Optimize data retrieval by building array equivalents
obj.tags_array = {}
obj.tags_array_len = 0
obj.tags_keys = {}
for k, _ in pairs(obj.tags) do
    table.insert(obj.tags_keys, k)
end
table.sort(obj.tags_keys)
for _, k in ipairs(obj.tags_keys) do
    obj.tags_array_len = obj.tags_array_len + 1
    local v = obj.tags[k]
    v.index = obj.tags_array_len
    table.insert(obj.tags_array, v)
end
-- obj.aliases_keys = {}
-- for k, _ in pairs(obj.aliases) do
--     table.insert(obj.aliases_keys, k)
-- end

obj.quotes = _m_quote_db.quotes

-- Link quotes to tags (and vice versa). Also convert interchanges into more machine-usable form.
for quote_i, quote in ipairs(obj.quotes) do
    quote.index = quote_i
    table.insert(obj.tags["all"].quotes, quote_i)
    if type(quote.quote) == "table" then
        local new_quote = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(quote.quote) do
            for key, val in pairs(line) do
                local key_lc = string.lower(key)
                if key_lc ~= "quote_marks" then
                    table.insert(new_quote, {
                        participant = obj.aliases[key_lc].index,
                        text = val,
                        quote_marks = line.quote_marks
                    })
                end
            end
        end
        quote.quote = new_quote
    end
    local tags = nil
    for _, key in ipairs({"speakers", "addressees", "tags", "pseudosource"}) do
        local is_table = true
        local value = quote[key]
        if type(value) ~= "table" then
            is_table = false
            value = { value }
        end
        if value then
            local new_list = nil
            -- new_list = _m_utils._table_union(new_list, value)
            for _, alias in ipairs(value) do
                if alias then
                    local add = true
                    if new_list == nil then
                        new_list = {}
                    else
                        for _, a in ipairs(new_list) do
                            if a == nil then
                                add = false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if add then table.insert(new_list, obj.aliases[string.lower(alias)].index) end
                end
            end
            if new_list then
                quote[key] = is_table and new_list or new_list[1]
                if not tags then tags = {} end
                _m_utils._table_union(tags, new_list)
            else
                quote[key] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    quote.tags = tags
    for _, tag_index in ipairs(quote.tags) do
        local tag = obj.tags_array[tag_index]
        if not tag then error("Tag not found: "..tag_index) end
        if not tag.quotes then
            tag.quotes = { quote_i }
        else
            local add = true
            for _, q in ipairs(tag.quotes) do
                if quote_i == q then
                    add = false
                    break
                end
            end
            if add then table.insert(tag.quotes, quote_i) end
        end
    end
end

-- Replace indeces to quotes/tags with references.
-- Decreases retrieval time / code complexity.
for _, t in ipairs(obj.tags_array) do
    if t.quotes then
        local quotes = t.quotes
        t.quotes = {}
        for _, q in ipairs(quotes) do table.insert(t.quotes, { _wotwiki_raw = true, _val = string.format("obj.quotes[%d]", q) }) end
    end
end

--     end

for k, v in pairs(obj.tags) do obj.tags[k] = { _wotwiki_raw = true, _val = string.format("obj.tags_array[%d]", v.index) } end
for k, v in pairs(obj.aliases) do obj.aliases[k] = { _wotwiki_raw = true, _val = string.format("obj.tags_array[%d]", v.index) } end

obj.output = ""..
    "-- DO NOT MODIFY THIS FILE except to replace it with the script output. This\n"..
    "-- content is automatically generated by a script. Either the database source\n"..
    "-- file for the script or the script itself should be modified instead.\n\n"..
    "-- Database is at https://wot.fandom.com/wiki/Module:Quote/Data\n"..
    "-- Script is at https://wot.fandom.com/wiki/Module:Quote/Data/Cacher\n"..
    "-- Script output is at https://wot.fandom.com/wiki/Module:Quote/Data/Cacher/out\n\n"..
    "local obj = {}\n\n"..
    _m_utils._serialize(obj.quotes,     "obj.quotes",        0, true, false).."\n\n"..
    _m_utils._serialize(obj.tags_array, "obj.tags_array",    0, true, false).."\n\n"..
    _m_utils._serialize(obj.tags,       "obj.tags",          0, true, false).."\n\n"..
    _m_utils._serialize(obj.aliases,    "obj.aliases",       0, true, false).."\n\n"..
    "return obj"

return obj
